archetype.note: DECK_ARCHETYPE_BUDGETS is Commander-only; a 60-card deck is read against the midrange band of strategy:sixty-card, and each axis's quote carries the aggro and control bands beside it

measured.how: land copies from deck-facts (copies, not entries)

target.quote: an aggressive 60-card deck runs 20 to 24 lands, a midrange deck 24 to 26, a control deck 26 to 28, and the count is set by the turn the deck must hit on time, not by the average mana value alone

measured.how: land copies that enter tapped with no condition and no pay-life escape
measured.note: mana_analysis.lands.enters_tapped is a substring superset and counts both groups together

target.quote: an aggressive 60-card deck runs zero to four lands that enter tapped, a midrange deck four to eight, a control deck eight to twelve, and each one is a turn of the opponent's clock that twenty life does not refund

measured.how: copies carrying any of removal:spot, removal:damage, removal:edict, removal:fight, removal:debuff, removal:bounce, removal:tax, counterspell, hate:graveyard, removal:sweeper

target.quote: an aggressive 60-card deck runs 8 to 12 cheap interactive spells, a midrange deck 10 to 14, and a control deck 16 to 22 counting counterspells, removal and sweepers together
an aggressive 60-card deck runs 24 to 30 creatures, 16 to 24 of them at one or two mana; a midrange deck 12 to 18 creatures plus noncreature threats; a control deck 0 to 4

measured.how: front-face creature copies — the section counts bodies for the second wave after a sweeper, not wincon roles

target.quote: an aggressive 60-card deck must keep a clock after one sweeper — enough creatures that two waves of two or three threats are in hand by the midgame, a count in the mid-twenties, not the teens

measured.how: oracle-text heuristic over interactive cards; counterspells deliberately excluded — a counter answers a permanent only on the way in

target.quote: one opponent, answers without breadth; 20 life, a tapped land is a real tax; a sideboard, the sixty need not answer everything

measured.how: nonland copies by mana value (copies, not entries)

target.quote: an aggressive 60-card deck puts 16 to 24 cards at one or two mana and nothing above four; a midrange deck centres on two to four with a top end of five or six; a control deck runs its interaction at one to three and its finishers above its opponent's FT

measured.how: cards.json sideboard copies (absent when the list declared none)
measured.note: a sideboard is optional by the rules; zero means the list has not declared its fifteen, not that it has none to declare

target.quote: The sideboard is "at most fifteen cards" brought in "to tailor their deck toward winning the next game" (Duke) — answers to the metagame, not more maindeck

engine.reason: no goldfish_targets.json — the deck has not declared what it is trying to assemble

bracket_report.json.why: the bracket is a Commander construct

not_measured.card-advantage: the corpus states no card-draw count for a 60-card deck
not_measured.mana-sources: Burgess's formula budgets a commander's mana value against a 99-card base
not_measured.power: the bracket is a Commander construct
not_measured.protection: the corpus states no protection count for a 60-card deck; Zupke's 5-7 slots are a Commander structure
not_measured.ramp: the 60-card corpus sets the land count by the turn the deck must hit on time and states no ramp count
not_measured.sweepers: the 60-card corpus counts sweepers inside the interaction total, counterspells, removal and sweepers together, and states no separate wipe count
not_measured.tutors: the corpus gives a tutor count only inside Commander's combo archetype

notes: A modern deck: the targets are the 60-card table (strategy:sixty-card), read against its MIDRANGE band whatever the frame says — no archetype override table exists for a 60-card deck, and each axis's quote carries the aggro and control bands beside it. The axes under `not measured` are absent with a reason, not zero.

Permanent class(es) with no answer detected: artifact, creature, enchantment, graveyard, land. The detection is an oracle-text heuristic and counterspells are excluded from it, so this is a floor on breadth — read the cards before calling a class uncovered.
No engine block: no goldfish_targets.json — the deck has not declared what it is trying to assemble. Authoring goldfish_targets.json is what makes the engine questions answerable at all.
Roles come from card_roles.json, which classifies 93.3% of this deck. An axis count is a floor: a card the taxonomy has no pattern for is invisible to it, not absent from the deck.
